issue_context.title: Numeric Value field showing non-numeric value unavailable - Speedtest
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Like so many integrations, Speedtest.net is also affected by the issue of HA trying to validate numeric sensors as numeric value, but during startup these are in unavailable state, which generates warnings in the log.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.2.2

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Speedtest.net

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/speedtestdotnet/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
2023-02-05 19:01:59.848 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Sensor sensor.speedtest_ping has device class None, state class measurement and unit ms thus indicating it has a numeric value; however, it has the non-numeric value: unavailable (<class 'str'>); Please update your configuration if your entity is manually configured, otherwise create a bug report at https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22integration%3A+speedtestdotnet%22
2023-02-05 19:01:59.851 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Sensor sensor.speedtest_download has device class None, state class measurement and unit Mbit/s thus indicating it has a numeric value; however, it has the non-numeric value: unavailable (<class 'str'>); Please update your configuration if your entity is manually configured, otherwise create a bug report at https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22integration%3A+speedtestdotnet%22
2023-02-05 19:01:59.854 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Sensor sensor.speedtest_upload has device class None, state class measurement and unit Mbit/s thus indicating it has a numeric value; however, it has the non-numeric value: unavailable (<class 'str'>); Please update your configuration if your entity is manually configured, otherwise create a bug report at https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22integration%3A+speedtestdotnet%22
```


### Additional information

_No response_

Pull request #87519 might clear this issue soon.

@realthk no, issue #87519 will not fix this.
The problem is that `speedtestdotnet/sensor.py` is extending `RestoreEntity` when it should instead extend `RestoreSensor` which stores the sensor's native value instead of its state

Still an issue on:

Home Assistant 2023.4.6
Supervisor 2023.04.1
Operating System 10.1
Frontend 20230411.1 - latest
